name: Foam Bedroll
description: A closed-cell mat rolled around its own straps. It is not soft. It is between you and the floor, which is the part that matters.

name: Straw Pallet
description: Loose straw stitched into a ticking cover. It smells of a barn and it prickles through the seams, and nobody who has slept on boards complains.

name: Canvas Tarp
description: Heavy proofed canvas with brass eyelets worn oval. Folded double it is a mattress; strung up it is a roof.

name: Nylon Hammock
description: A packet of ripstop with the whole hammock crammed into it. Slung right, it keeps a sleeper off wet ground entirely.

name: Synthetic Sleeping Bag
description: A hollowfibre bag with a broken zip pull, knotted through with wire. It keeps its loft even damp, which down does not.

name: Dome Tent
description: A two-person dome in a stuff sack, poles lashed alongside. Pitched indoors it is a small warm room inside a cold one.

name: Down Sleeping Bag
description: An expedition bag, baffled and absurdly light for its bulk. Somebody was going somewhere serious and did not get to go.

name: Self-Inflating Mattress
description: A valve, a foam core and a skin that drinks air on its own if you leave it long enough. The best night anybody here is getting.

name: Box of Soap Flakes
description: Laundry flakes gone half to powder in a split carton. They lather badly and they still count.

name: Bar of Soap
description: A shrink-wrapped hotel bar, cracked across the middle. Cleanliness that outlasts the wash it was used in.

name: Bottle of Hand Gel
description: Alcohol gel with a pump that sticks. It strips a pair of hands back to nothing living, and it stings the cracks.

name: Field Surgical Kit
description: A roll of instruments in sterile foil, needle drivers and curved needles laid in order. It closes what a bandage only covers.

name: Hank of Paracord
description: Sheathed nylon line wound into a hank. Gutted for the inner strands it is sewing thread, whole it holds a ridgeline.

name: Spool of Fishing Line
description: Monofilament on a plastic spool, stiff with age. Invisible at knee height, which has uses beyond the water.

name: Sheet of Canvas
description: Duck canvas cut off a bolt, the selvedge still raw. Sacking, patching, a door where a door is missing.

name: Bundle of Tent Stakes
description: Steel pegs bent at the head, bundled with a perished rubber band. They hold a guy line or a tarpaulin or a snare.

name: Aluminium Pole Section
description: A shock-corded tent pole missing its partner. Light, straight, and stronger than it has any right to be.

name: Scalpel
description: A steel handle with a fresh blade clipped on, in a paper sleeve. It takes up almost no room at all, which is the whole argument for carrying one.

name: Long-Handled Bolt Cutters
description: Compound handles longer than an arm, jaws chipped at the tip. Whatever they are opening, they are not going in a pocket.

name: Set of Picks
description: Rakes and a tension wrench in a leather fold. Patience in a wallet, for somebody who already has the patience.

name: Field Binoculars
description: Rubber-armoured and fogged in one barrel. The good barrel still brings a far street close enough to argue about.

name: Telescopic Rod
description: A travel rod collapsed into its own butt section, reel seat empty. The river is still there and the river does not know.
